title: OL-20261115-26: Tripwire paths need a disposition, including content already public
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** daily lane sweep and any change to doctrine/publication.json
**Done check:** grep:ops/publication/ledger.jsonl::"ultrastable": "clean"
**Status:** open

ultrastable/ultrastable has been public since 2026-11-10 with NEEDS-YOU.md, business/ (investor, funding), data/, external/, ip/, ops/ and outreach/ in tree and history; workers has ops/. None has a disposition in ops/publication/reviewed.json (publish, move, remove). Removing a path from a public repo's history needs a rewrite and does not recall copies. Default in effect: nothing is removed and workers is not flipped.
